summary: Pharming Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US 8-K) disclosing a UK MHRA regulatory approval, not a corporate transaction. The MHRA extended the Joenja (leniolisib) marketing authorization to children aged 4-11 weighing at least 27 kg with APDS, with 40 mg and 50 mg twice-daily dosing; product availability under the expanded label is expected February 2027. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine clinical/regulatory milestone; no risk-arb angle applies.
